subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Should the remaining seven seams stay sponsored as one bounded core-hardening program, with each seam still requiring separate owner approval?
rationale: Source confirms the duplication pattern, but selecting permanent owners across session, provider/plugin, tool, error, and subagent boundaries requires maintainer architecture and sequencing intent.

options.title: Keep bounded umbrella
options.body: Retain this tracker for sequencing while requiring one focused issue or PR, owner review, and proof per seam.

options.title: Split sponsored seams
options.body: Create separate canonical issues only for the remaining rows maintainers explicitly prioritize, then retire the umbrella.

options.title: Stop planned program
options.body: Close the tracker and address future duplication only when tied to a concrete regression or separately sponsored refactor.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this tracker for sequencing while requiring one focused issue or PR, owner review, and proof per seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent broad core architecture and vision work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding whether the cross-core program remains sponsored.
